== Summary ==
Errata sheet slip, 17 September 2007: •Tusken Breath Mask (V), as printed on the Players Committee's errata sheet “Errata: September 17, 2007” for [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]]. The slip is the same as the one on the Committee's re-edited set sheet.

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf] (swccgpc.com, “Errata: September 17, 2007”, PDF dated 14 September 2007; Internet Archive capture 26 October 2007), page 1, slip 22. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (Remastered 2006)|Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8) (Errata)]].
